title: Resource allocation under strict service priorities with temporal smoothing and ramp limits
description: Open research software and recorded experiments for allocating a divisible resource under fixed service priorities. The implementation selects allocations on priority optimal faces using quadratic temporal smoothing, supports weighted service metrics and hierarchical capacities, and handles ramp limits with explicit emergency actions. The package includes comparisons with exponential smoothing, regularized online balanced descent, an absolute movement penalty and predictive control with persistence or oracle forecasts. Full horizon clairvoyant solutions, numerical bound checks, dataset manifests, saved trajectories, tests and figure generation scripts are included. The electricity and bike rental datasets are retrieved from the UCI Machine Learning Repository by a checksum verified downloader. Capacities, priority classes and disruptions are constructed experimental parameters. Code is licensed under MIT. Original results and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Editable manuscript sources and editorial documents are excluded.
